name: Hoi An summer beach festival
nameVi: Hội An - Cảm xúc mùa hè
summary: A summer of beach events on the Hoi An coast. In 2024 it ran at Cửa Đại, Tân Thành, An Bàng, and Cù Lao Chàm, opening at Cửa Đại with dance, music, food, a DJ, fire performance, beach games, kites, and OCOP stalls. In July, An Bàng held Mùa hè bất tận: sea-themed work in lanterns and recycled wood, coastal food, beach music, and sport.
when: 15 June to 21 July in 2024. Later years’ dates: confirm locally.
